business_summary: Everjoy Health Group Co.,Ltd. engages in the production and sale of building materials in China. It offers vitrified stone, marble, marble slabs, glazed tiles, rock slabs, and artistic porcelain, supplemented by exterior wall cladding, decorative tiles, border tiles, corner tiles, and other accessories. The company is also involved in the health care and medical care services; investment management; hotel operations; and offers training and education services. Health Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
